hooks.command: root="$PWD"; while [ "$root" != "/" ]; do hook="$root/.codex/hooks/context_freshness_gate.py"; if [ -f "$hook" ]; then exec python3 "$hook"; fi; root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; exit 1
hooks.commandWindows: $dir = (Get-Location).Path; while ($dir) { $hook = Join-Path $dir '.codex/hooks/context_freshness_gate.py'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hook) { & py -3 -X utf8 $hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dir; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $dir) { break }; $dir = $parent }; exit 1
